userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for quality focus area
userStories.notes: Seed story. Generated 11 quality-focused stories (US-77-002 through US-77-012). Focused on wiring existing but unused scoring functions (semantic/temporal coherence), explanation validation integration, chapter-type query learning, adaptive confidence tuning, match diversity improvements, and scoring audit trail enhancements.

userStories.title: Wire semantic coherence scoring into TieredMatcher
acceptanceCriteria: compute_semantic_coherence from src/matching/scoring.py is called in all 3 match paths (fast_path, with_llm, embedding_only) in src/matching/tiered_matcher.py
Previous segment's embedding is stored and passed to compute_semantic_coherence for the current segment
The semantic coherence adjustment appears in confidence_breakdown as 'semantic_coherence' entry
When semantic_coherence_enabled=False in config, no adjustment is applied (backward compat)
New tests verify: smooth transition boost, abrupt transition penalty, disabled returns 0.0, first segment (no previous) returns 0.0
userStories.notes: DONE. Added _apply_semantic_coherence helper method, set_embedding_lookup, _get_segment_embedding to TieredMatcher. Wired into all 3 match paths (obvious, high-similarity, LLM). main.py calls set_embedding_lookup after embedding search creation. 7 new integration tests in test_semantic_coherence.py. All 41 tests pass.

userStories.title: Wire temporal coherence scoring into TieredMatcher
acceptanceCriteria: compute_temporal_coherence from src/matching/scoring.py is called in all 3 match paths in src/matching/tiered_matcher.py
Previous match's video source_file is tracked and passed for temporal continuity detection
The temporal coherence adjustment appears in confidence_breakdown as 'temporal_coherence' entry
Same-source boost (+0.05 default) is applied when consecutive segments match the same video
Context-switch penalty is applied when consecutive segments switch to different video sources
When temporal_coherence_enabled=False in config, no adjustment is applied
userStories.notes: DONE. Added _apply_temporal_coherence helper method and _previous_match_segment tracking to TieredMatcher. Imported compute_temporal_coherence from scoring.py. Wired into all 3 match paths (obvious, high-similarity, LLM) right after semantic coherence. Records 'temporal_coherence' in breakdown. Updates _previous_match_segment after each match for continuity. All 39 temporal coherence tests pass, all 33 chapter/contract tests pass.

userStories.title: Wire explanation validation into LLM match path
acceptanceCriteria: validate_explanation_confidence from src/matching/llm_providers.py is called after LLM matching in match_segment_with_llm
When explanation validation fails (is_valid=False), confidence is penalized by the penalty_factor
The validation result appears in confidence_breakdown as 'explanation_validation' entry
When explanation_validation_enabled=False in config, validation is skipped
Tests verify: valid explanation passes through unchanged, invalid explanation receives penalty, disabled config skips validation
userStories.notes: Tier: feature (medium). validate_explanation_confidence exists at src/matching/llm_providers.py:242 with full implementation (keyword extraction, verification ratio, penalty calculation). It is NEVER called from tiered_matcher.py:match_segment_with_llm. The function returns ExplanationValidation with is_valid, confidence_penalty, and verified_keywords. Need to call it after LLM returns a match explanation, and apply penalty_factor if validation fails. Tests exist in tests/test_explanation_validation.py for the function itself. Source files: src/matching/llm_providers.py:242-330, src/matching/tiered_matcher.py:1050-1160.

userStories.title: Add chapter-type aware query strategy ranking to iterative match
acceptanceCriteria: QueryLearning in src/iterative_match/query_learning.py tracks query success rates per chapter_type (intro, body, conclusion, listicle_item)
When generating queries for a gap, the learner boosts strategies that historically perform well for that chapter type
Gap segments annotated with chapter_type from gap_analyzer.py propagate their type to query learning
Tests verify: strategy success is recorded per chapter_type, query ranking differs between intro and body chapters, missing chapter_type defaults to 'body'
userStories.notes: Tier: feature (medium). src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py:102-104 already annotates GapSegment with chapter_type ('intro', 'body', 'conclusion', 'listicle_item'). src/iterative_match/query_learning.py exists but has no chapter_type awareness. US-76-005 wired chapter-type strategy ranking into iterative match query generation, but query_learning.py doesn't track success rates per chapter_type for learning. Need to: (1) add chapter_type field to learning records, (2) weight historical performance by chapter_type when ranking strategies. Source files: src/iterative_match/query_learning.py, src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py:100-110, src/stages/iterative_match.py:878-920.

userStories.title: Add adaptive confidence floor with chapter-type awareness
acceptanceCriteria: Confidence floor in apply_all_adjustments can vary by chapter type (intro/conclusion segments get lower floor of 0.03, body gets default 0.05)
The chapter_type is resolved from segment_chapter_map or defaults to 'body' when unknown
Configuration option matching.scoring.adaptive_confidence_floor_enabled toggles this behavior (default: true)
When disabled, the static confidence_floor (0.05) is used for all segments as before
Tests verify: intro segment gets lower floor, body segment gets default floor, unknown chapter_type gets default floor, disabled config uses static floor
userStories.notes: Tier: feature (small). Currently confidence_floor is a static 0.05 applied uniformly at src/matching/scoring.py:3676-3683. Intro/conclusion segments are more important and should be allowed to survive with lower confidence rather than being floored out. Need to: (1) accept chapter_type parameter in apply_all_adjustments, (2) look up per-type floor, (3) add config toggle. Source files: src/matching/scoring.py:3676-3683, src/matching/scoring.py:2893-2898, src/config/sections/matching.py.

userStories.title: Add match diversity enforcement across voiceover chapters
acceptanceCriteria: After initial matching completes, a post-processing pass checks if any voiceover chapter uses only a single video source for all segments
When a chapter has >4 segments all from the same source, mark lowest-confidence segments as candidates for re-matching with source exclusion
The diversity pass is configurable via matching.chapter_grouping.min_source_diversity (default: 2, meaning at least 2 different sources per chapter)
A confidence_breakdown entry 'diversity_recheck' is added to segments that were re-matched
Tests verify: all-same-source chapter triggers re-match, chapter with adequate diversity is untouched, config min_source_diversity=1 disables the check
userStories.notes: Tier: feature (medium). Currently chapter_source_consistency boosts same-source within chapters (good), but there's no guard against pathological cases where an entire chapter maps to a single video. This creates monotonous timelines. Need a post-processing pass in src/matching/tiered_matcher.py after the main match loop. Source files: src/matching/tiered_matcher.py (new method after match loop), src/matching/scoring.py (confidence_breakdown entry), src/config/sections/matching.py:186-192 (add min_source_diversity field).

userStories.title: Add scoring adjustment audit summary to match stage output
acceptanceCriteria: After match stage completes, a summary log line reports: total segments matched, average confidence, count of each scoring adjustment that fired (title_relevance, chapter_topic_match, etc.)
Adjustments that never fired are reported as 'unused' to help identify dead config
The summary is logged at INFO level and includes the top-3 most impactful adjustments by average magnitude
Tests verify: summary includes all active adjustment names, unused adjustments are flagged, average magnitudes are computed correctly
userStories.notes: Tier: feature (small). Currently confidence_breakdown is per-segment and only visible in debug logs. There's no aggregate view of which scoring adjustments are actually contributing across all segments. This makes tuning difficult. Need to: (1) collect all confidence_breakdown dicts after matching, (2) compute aggregate stats, (3) log summary. Source files: src/matching/tiered_matcher.py (add summary method called after match loop), src/stages/match.py (call summary after tiered_matcher returns).

userStories.title: Add embedding search result deduplication by video source
acceptanceCriteria: EmbeddingSearch._search_candidates in src/matching/embedding_search.py deduplicates results so the same video_id appears at most max_per_source times (default: 3) in the candidate pool
After deduplication, additional candidates from other sources are pulled in to maintain the target candidate count
Configuration option matching.embedding_search.max_candidates_per_source (default: 3) controls the cap
Tests verify: 10 candidates from same source get capped to 3, remaining slots filled from other sources, max_candidates_per_source=0 disables dedup
userStories.notes: Tier: feature (small). Currently embedding_search.py returns top-K candidates by similarity with no source diversity constraint. If a single popular video has many good segments, it dominates the candidate pool, reducing downstream diversity. The chapter_boost in _apply_chapter_boost (~line 130) helps but only when chapters exist. Need to add source-diversity filtering. Source files: src/matching/embedding_search.py:29-130 (EmbeddingSearch class), src/config/sections/matching.py (add EmbeddingSearchConfig field).

userStories.title: Add confidence calibration using segment duration ratio
acceptanceCriteria: A new scoring adjustment apply_duration_ratio_calibration in src/matching/scoring.py adjusts confidence based on the ratio of video segment duration to voiceover segment duration
When video segment is >3x longer than voiceover segment, apply a -0.03 penalty (excessive content, likely poor fit)
When video segment is <0.3x the voiceover segment duration, apply a -0.05 penalty (too short, will need padding)
When ratio is between 0.5-2.0x, no adjustment (acceptable range)
The adjustment appears in confidence_breakdown as 'duration_ratio_calibration'
Tests verify: ratio 1.0 gives no penalty, ratio 5.0 gives -0.03, ratio 0.1 gives -0.05, missing duration data gives no penalty
userStories.notes: Tier: feature (small). apply_duration_penalty at src/matching/scoring.py:137 exists but uses speed_ratio (playback speed matching). This new adjustment is about content duration fit - a 2-second voiceover matched to a 30-second video segment is suspicious. Source files: src/matching/scoring.py (new function after ~line 560), src/matching/tiered_matcher.py (call in all 3 match paths), src/matching/scoring.py:3470 (add to apply_all_adjustments).

userStories.title: Add entity match boost propagation to confidence breakdown
acceptanceCriteria: apply_entity_match_boost at src/matching/scoring.py:802 records its graduated boost values in confidence_breakdown with detailed reason text
The breakdown entry includes: matched entity names, match type (exact/partial), and boost value applied
When no entities match, no breakdown entry is added (avoid noise)
The entity match information is included in the scoring audit summary (US-77-008)
Tests verify: exact entity match shows entity name in breakdown, partial match shows match type, zero-entity case adds no entry
userStories.notes: Tier: bugfix (small). apply_entity_match_boost at src/matching/scoring.py:802 already applies graduated boosts (+0.03/+0.06/+0.10) but may not record full details in confidence_breakdown including which entities matched and the match type. This makes debugging entity matching difficult. Need to check current breakdown output and enhance it. Source files: src/matching/scoring.py:802-930.

userStories.title: Add low-confidence segment reporting with suggested remediation
acceptanceCriteria: After matching, segments with confidence below LOW_CONFIDENCE_WARNING_THRESHOLD (0.15) are collected and logged at WARNING level
Each low-confidence warning includes: segment index, voiceover text preview (first 50 chars), confidence value, top 3 negative adjustments from confidence_breakdown
When >20% of segments are low-confidence, a summary WARNING suggests enabling iterative matching or adjusting scoring weights
Tests verify: segment at 0.10 triggers warning, segment at 0.20 does not, >20% threshold triggers summary warning, empty match list produces no warnings
userStories.notes: Tier: feature (small). LOW_CONFIDENCE_WARNING_THRESHOLD exists at src/matching/scoring.py:2893 as 0.15 but is only used for individual debug-level logging. There's no aggregate low-confidence reporting that helps users understand match quality at a glance. Source files: src/matching/tiered_matcher.py (add reporting method after match loop), src/matching/scoring.py:2893 (threshold constant).
